title: Bill of Materials
description: New since the pre-restructure schema set (migration 0019). The flat engineering/spec parts list for one Asset Request, one BOM per request. Matches public.bill_of_materials, with public.bill_of_materials_lines embedded as the `lines` array. A finalized line can be converted into a Procurement Item (see procurement-plan/procurement-item.schema.json) via the app's 'Generate Procurement Items from Parts List' action -- lines.procurementItemId records that link once made.

assetRequestId.description: FK -> capex-plan/asset-request.id. One BOM per Asset Request (unique).

statusId.description: FK -> lookup_options.id, list_key = 'bom_status' (Draft, Submitted, Approved, Converted, Cancelled). Informational only -- not enforced as an edit-lock.

estimatedTotalCost.description: Trigger-maintained sum of lines[].estimatedTotalCost (migration 0025). Read-only from the app's perspective.

estimatedUnitCost.description: Optional at this stage -- refined once real quotes come in.

procurementItemId.description: FK -> procurement-plan/procurement-item.id, set once this line is converted. Partial-unique live (a Procurement Item can only be claimed by one line).
